newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold, silver end higher in post-budget trade.
newsitem.headline: India gold, silver end higher in post-budget trade.

text.p: ** Silver (.999) ends 20 rupees higher at 7,620 rupees per kg in a special trading session on Friday held after the presentation of the federal budget against the previous closing of 7,605 rupees.

** Gold 24 carat finishes 60 rupees up at 4,950 rupees per 10 grammes against the previous closing of 4,890 rupees on seasonal buying and speculative enqueries, triggered by an uptrend in the world market.
** Prices of gold biscuits (116.50 grammes each) close 800 rupees higher at 58,000 rupees per piece against the previous day's 57,200 rupees.
